tan_berth_signed.accept_append: The dead city is the Gadgetzan Ruins, west of the port across the open sand.

tan_berth_done.accept_append: The shore I mean is the Drownbell cove, south-west of the port gate.

tan_gad_mazzic.accept_append: Gadgetzan Ruins. West of the port, and further than it looks.

tan_gad_the_answer.accept_append: The hexxers are further on than the city - Zul'Farrak Ruins, west past Gadgetzan, on the far side of the desert.

tan_gad_the_press_again.accept_append: It is Zul'Farrak's east gate they hold - far west of here, beyond the dead city.

tan_gad_salvage.accept_append: All of it is in the Gadgetzan Ruins, west of the port. The scavengers pick over the same streets.

tan_zf_what_happened.accept_append: Zul'Farrak Ruins. As far west as Tanaris goes, past the dead city.

tan_zf_the_marks.accept_append: Zul'Farrak Ruins are at the far west of the desert, beyond Gadgetzan. You cannot miss a pyramid.

tan_zf_the_offer.accept_append: They are at Zul'Farrak Ruins, west across the whole desert. Nobody from this town has walked it to ask.

tan_zf_the_axe.accept_append: The Sandfury are at Zul'Farrak Ruins, at the western end of the desert.

tan_cove_whose_claim.accept_append: The cove is the Drownbell, south-west of the port gate.

tan_cove_the_bell.accept_append: The mouth of the Drownbell is south-west of the port, where the shore turns.

tan_cove_the_warden.accept_append: The Drownbell cove, south-west of our gate. You know the shore by now.

tan_cove_vaile.accept_append: The Drownbell, south-west of the port. One more time.

tan_solo_counter.accept_append: They come up from the Drownbell cove, south-west of the gate, and they go back the same way.

tan_road_nothing_back.accept_append: The road runs west from our gate before it turns north for the pan. The raptors have that first stretch.

tan_solo_bird.accept_append: The birds roost over the Bonefields, west of the port. The post I mean is north of the dead city.
